checks.description: `dsh-ppt audit` reports ok with no error-level finding
the published deck has the requested number of slides
every slide carries at least one native text shape (no full-page bitmap slides)
the package has exactly one slide master
a native chart part (`ppt/charts/*.xml` with a `c:chartSpace` root) exists
a native table (`a:tbl`) exists in a slide
`assets/image_sources.json`, when present, records a licence and an author per item
the deck manifest binds a theme file that exists
